packageRules.description: Third-party GitHub Actions updates wait three days after release, then Renovate automerges them. The hive also merges Renovate PRs once the required checks pass, because mergeraptor is a trusted bot.
First-party projectbluefin/** actions merge right away and open at any time.

sync-templates.yml is a human-merge path in the hive (it holds the MergeRaptor App key that writes to other repos). Give its updates their own branches, so a pin-only update to it is a PR of its own that the hive's pin-only exception can merge, instead of being held with other workflows.
Renovate never automerges GitHub Actions majors. The hive's trusted-bot merge policy is independent of this setting.
